newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Electricidad may get 78 pct hike - source.
newsitem.headline: Electricidad may get 78 pct hike - source.

text.p: Venezuela's Electric Regulatory Commission (CREE) has recommended that stock market bellwether Electricidad de Caracas receive a 78 percent rate hike, a source at the Ministry of Energy and Mines said.
The rate rise still has to be approved by the government, but "the average increase will be 78 percent (in the year)," the source told Reuters.
"There'll be a 25 percent rise in May followed by further raises until the end of the year," it added. The source said Electricidad had asked for higher increase.
The Ministry of Energy and Mines sits in on the CREE.
Last Friday, Venezuela's cabinet of economic ministers approved the CREE's proposed framework to govern electricity rate increases.

Officials said, however, that the exact amount of the increase had not yet been finally decided and that the rate increase would only be phased in after President Rafael Caldera had given his final approval.
